label: Highest index wins
subgoals: Scan the request vector from the top bit down
Stop at the first asserted bit
Report its index and raise the valid flag

label: Lowest index wins
subgoals: Scan the request vector from bit zero upward
Isolate the lowest set bit with x AND minus x
Encode the isolated bit as its index

label: Leading-zero counting for normalization
subgoals: Locate the highest set bit with a priority encoder
Subtract its index from the word width minus one
Use the count as the normalization shift amount
